attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates DC First-Time Homebuyer Credit. Credit is lesser of $5,000 or purchase price. Subject to phase-out at higher income levels. Must be first-time homebuyer in DC during qualified period per Form 8859.

condition_details.condition_comment: Purchased DC home as first-time buyer
Purchase price is greater than zero

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Process Form 2555 Foreign Earned Income Exclusion. Allows US citizens/residents abroad to exclude up to $126,500 of foreign earned income per IRC 911.

context_details.context_comment: Process each foreign earned income record
context_details.context_description: for all foreign earned income records
context_details.context_postfix: 0.0 /result.total_foreign_earned_income xdef 0.0 /result.foreign_earned_income_exclusion xdef 0.0 /result.foreign_housing_exclusion xdef "Processing Form 2555 Foreign Earned Income Exclusion (IRC 911)" job.audit_trail swap addto { /Process_Foreign_Earned_Income executetable } job.foreign_earned_incomes forall

condition_details.condition_description: Meets bona fide residence or physical presence test

action_details.action_description: Calculate DC homebuyer credit (lesser of $5,000 or purchase price)
action_details.action_postfix:
"Calculating DC First-Time Homebuyer Credit (Form 8859)" job.audit_trail swap addto 5000.0 job.dc_home_purchase_price fmin /result.dc_homebuyer_credit xdef " Purchase price: $" job.dc_home_purchase_price cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " DC Homebuyer Credit: $" result.dc_homebuyer_credit cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto set result.feie_exclusion = the minimum of foreign_earned_income and feie_limit
foreign_earned_income.foreign_wages foreign_earned_income.foreign_se_income f+ result.total_foreign_earned_income f+ /result.total_foreign_earned_income xdef result.total_foreign_earned_income feie_max_exclusion fmin result.foreign_earned_income_exclusion f+ /result.foreign_earned_income_exclusion xdef true /foreign_earned_income.qualifies_exclusion xdef foreign_earned_income.housing_expenses feie_housing_base f- 0 fmax feie_housing_max feie_housing_base f- fmin /foreign_earned_income.housing_exclusion xdef foreign_earned_income.housing_exclusion result.foreign_housing_exclusion f+ /result.foreign_housing_exclusion xdef " Foreign earned income: $" result.total_foreign_earned_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " FEIE exclusion: $" result.foreign_earned_income_exclusion cvs strconcat " (max $" strconcat feie_max_exclusion cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

"DC Homebuyer Credit not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto set result.feie_exclusion = 0
false /foreign_earned_income.qualifies_exclusion xdef " Does not qualify for FEIE - did not meet residence or presence test" job.audit_trail swap addto
